annotations.title: Read sales attributed to one post

description: Show the matched orders and link opens for one post, resolved from the account’s per-post figures, and report THREE figures that must not be mixed up: this post’s revenue, the revenue attributed across all posts, and what the shop actually took — some of which is tied to no post at all. Read-only and free. It tells you which source reported what; it CANNOT prove a post caused a sale, and a missing value is NOT zero — say what is missing rather than inventing a number. The ids are Soclo post ids, not platform ids.

postId.description: The Soclo post id whose matched orders and link opens you want — the id Soclo gives a published post, not the platform’s. Its figures are selected from the account’s per-post totals; the account-wide and shop-wide figures are returned separately.
